title: A Little Sea for a Raindrop
originalStory: A tiny raindrop on a clover leaf wanted to see the sea. I held my blue ocean drawing beside it, and a little bit of blue shone inside the drop. Then it slipped into a small puddle, and I sat beside it so we could look at the picture together.
visualBible:
Mina: human child, age 5, normal human ears, short curly black hair, warm brown skin, yellow cardigan, teal trousers, white sneakers, small child-sized build.
Pip: tiny clear raindrop, round and silvery on a leaf, with no face, limbs, or clothing; becomes part of a shallow puddle, recognizable by a small glimmer of reflected blue.

pages.text: A tiny raindrop on a clover leaf wanted to see the sea—or so I imagined. I called it Pip and crouched on the soft garden grass. “The sea is far away,” I whispered, “but I have something to show you.”
pages.illustrationScene: Masal Kitabı storybook style, with soft watercolor textures and warm, delicate light. In a level garden clover patch after rain, Mina crouches comfortably on the grass beside Pip, a tiny natural raindrop resting on a low clover leaf. Mina wears a yellow cardigan and teal trousers and has short curly black hair and normal human ears. The mood is intimate and full of quiet wonder; no other characters are visible.

pages.text: I held my blue ocean drawing beside the leaf. A little bit of blue shone inside Pip, like a whole sea tucked into a bead. “Look,” I said, “I made you waves—and plenty of room.”
pages.illustrationScene: Masal Kitabı storybook style. A close, low view of the clover patch shows Mina safely seated on the grass, holding a paper drawing of broad blue crayon waves beside Pip on the clover leaf. Mina’s short curly black hair, normal human ears, yellow cardigan, and teal trousers remain consistent. Pip has no face or limbs; a tiny reflection of the blue drawing gleams within the clear drop. The drawing depicts only waves, with no people or boats.

pages.text: The clover leaf nodded in a breeze, and Pip slipped into a little puddle below. One tiny ring spread across the water, then another. For a moment, the puddle made waves of its own.
pages.illustrationScene: Masal Kitabı storybook style. An object-focused close-up beneath the low clover leaf shows a very small, ankle-width rain puddle, only a thin film of water in a shallow hollow of level garden ground. Pip has just joined the puddle, marked by a silvery glimmer at the center of two delicate spreading rings. The leaf arches above, and soft grass surrounds the water. No human characters are visible; the mood is gentle and quietly magical without faces or limbs on objects.

pages.text: I sat beside the puddle and held the picture where we could both see. “We can look together,” I told Pip, while the blue shimmered on the water. The sea was still far away, but beside me there was a little blue—and room for two.
pages.illustrationScene: Masal Kitabı storybook style. A wider view of the peaceful, level garden shows Mina sitting comfortably on dry grass beside the tiny, very shallow puddle, holding the blue ocean drawing low so its color reflects on the water. Mina has short curly black hair, normal human ears, a yellow cardigan, teal trousers, and white sneakers. Pip is now part of the puddle, represented by the small blue glimmer on its surface, with no face or limbs. Clover and soft grass frame the scene; no other characters appear. Warm light and generous open space create a tender feeling of companionship.
